description: §14.8.9 S443 round 6 (L2) — a helper that returns `arguments[0]` returns its argument; passing it the protected column and returning the result is E-PROTECT-006.
rationale: §14.8.9 (S441 amendment): provenance is preserved by default through every binding. `arguments` read as a free, clean name, so `first(u.passwordHash)` with `function first() { return arguments[0] }` served the hash over HTTP (measured, S443 round 6). `arguments` now carries the join of every argument.
